games.name: American Truck Simulator
games.short_description: Experience legendary American trucks and deliver various cargoes across sunny California, sandy Nevada, and the Grand Canyon State of Arizona. American Truck Simulator takes you on a journey through the breathtaking landscapes and widely recognized landmarks around the States.

descriptions.en: Experience legendary American trucks and deliver various cargoes across sunny California, sandy Nevada, and the Grand Canyon State of Arizona. American Truck Simulator takes you on a journey through the breathtaking landscapes and widely recognized landmarks around the States.

descriptions.ko: 전설적인 미국 트럭을 경험하고 햇살 가득한 캘리포니아, 모래가 많은 네바다, 애리조나주의 그랜드 캐니언 전역에서 다양한 화물을 배달하세요. American Truck Simulator는 숨 막힐 듯한 풍경과 미국 전역의 널리 알려진 랜드마크를 여행으로 안내합니다.

games.short_description: Set out on an epic journey to Iowa! Explore the Hawkeye State as you drive along the iconic I-80 to the capital city of Des Moines and discover charming towns along the Mississippi River.

descriptions.en: Set out on an epic journey to Iowa! Explore the Hawkeye State as you drive along the iconic I-80 to the capital city of Des Moines and discover charming towns along the Mississippi River.

games.short_description: Embark on a journey to the Pelican State nestled in the south of the U.S.. Discover the subtropical climate of the state, which has allowed the magnificent brooding scenery of coastal bayous, and lush, dank vegetation to thrive.

games.short_description: Get ready for an epic trucking journey to Missouri in American Truck Simulator! Explore vibrant cities and the state's diverse landscapes, from the rolling Ozark hills to charming small towns and vast farmlands.

descriptions.en: Get ready for an epic trucking journey to Missouri in American Truck Simulator! Explore vibrant cities and the state's diverse landscapes, from the rolling Ozark hills to charming small towns and vast farmlands.

descriptions.ja: 『American Truck Simulator』で、ミズーリ州へ壮大なトラックの旅に繰り出しましょう！活気あふれる都市部から、なだらかなオザーク丘陵、美しい田舎町、広大な農地まで、多彩な風景があなたを待っています。

games.short_description: Montana is home to extraordinary experiences and moments that will leave you in awe. Horizons frame the dramatic landscapes, including two spectacular national parks—Yellowstone and Glacier. Vast, unspoiled, and wild, “Big Sky State” represents the very best of the American West.

descriptions.zh-Hant: 蒙大拿州将令你心生敬畏，带给你非凡的体验与时光。这一美国的北部州拥有原始自然的野性之美。辽阔、未遭破坏和野性，“大天空之州”呈现了非常完美的美国西部景象。
descriptions.ja: モンタナ州には、あなたを驚かせるような素晴らしい体験や瞬間が数多くあります。地平線がドラマチックな風景を描き、その中には 2 つの壮大な国立公園、イエローストーン国立公園とグレイシャー国立公園があります。広大で、手つかずのままの、荒々しい「ビッグスカイステート」は、アメリカ西部の最高の象徴です。
descriptions.ko: 몬태나는 당신을 경외감에 빠뜨릴 놀라운 경험과 순간의 고향입니다. 수평선이 두 개의 멋진 옐로스톤 및 글레이셔 국립 공원을 포함하여 극적인 풍경을 구성합니다. 광대하고 손상되지 않았으며 거친 '빅 스카이주'는 미국 서부의 최고를 나타냅니다.

games.short_description: From the grand American highways running through the hills of dusk-red rock to leading cities bustling with culture, landmarks, and businesses, Oklahoma is a diverse state shaped by its history and industries.
